reason: Owner requested the next Sheep Tag Quest 2 VR UI updates: spatial floating, movable, tiltable/pinnable menus inspired by native Quest OS windows. Source verified PR #322 merged at e963912064dafde0c4f88b4d3d0fc2e04e046cf6. §E v11.207 introduces Play-only right grip-to-grab app-owned radial menus when the controller ray hits actual menu UI, moves/rotates/tilts in 6DoF under tracked controller, release pins in world across menu page changes/close/reopen, right-stick changes menu size while grabbed without changing sheep camera, and SESSION > LAYOUT provides PIN/RECENTER/SMALLER/LARGER. Cached GRIP TO MOVE handle/outline attached once per menu page; no new render loop or per-frame graphics allocation. A grip held before opening menus or while Quest system overlay is active cannot accidentally begin a grab without release and fresh press. Original XR reference-space camera tracking, v11.205 tactical view/menu foreground pointer, v11.204 A/X rapid-building and skills, v11.206 meadow/fog art, wolves, LAN authority, editor/modeler object rotation, non-VR input and 68 assets preserved. In-session world pins intentionally reset on next XR session because tracked physical reference coordinates may differ. 49 new behavior tests plus all prior v11.206–v11.181 XR/Sheep/editor/ARPG regressions PASS. Exact 239-ordered-patch 7,409,246-byte HTML SHA256 78eae7139cc5f356552855f67780db345a43c70ac38573ed8eaa604d9844a18a verified by GitHub Actions #41377611527. Not yet the full independent multi-panel editor/camera workspace and persistent layouts; Quest 2 physical FPS, grab comfort and menu interactions remain to be tested by owner.
